## What happened

A clear description of what went wrong.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open Formatrix
2. Select operation ...
3. Drop / open a file of type ...
4. Configure options ...
5. Click Process
6. See error / unexpected behaviour

## Expected behaviour

What you expected to happen.

## Actual behaviour

What actually happened. Include the error message shown in the UI if any.

## Platform

- OS: (e.g. macOS 14.4, Windows 11, Ubuntu 24.04)
- Formatrix version: (e.g. v1.0.0)
- How installed: (.dmg / .msi / .AppImage / .deb / built from source)

## Input file details

- File type: (e.g. JPEG, PDF, CSV)
- Approximate file size: (e.g. 3 MB)
- For PDFs: approximate page count, text-layer or scanned

Do not attach files containing personal, financial, or sensitive information.

## Screenshots

If the issue is visual, attach a screenshot.

## Additional context

Anything else that might be relevant.
